name: io.github.yezhiye/easyphotolayout
title: Easy Photo Layout
description: Plan passport and ID photo print sheets: supported sizes and copies per sheet.

tools.name: epl_list_presets
tools.description: List the photo sizes, paper sizes, and default spacing supported by Easy Photo Layout. Sizes are in millimeters.

tools.name: epl_plan_layout
tools.description: Calculate how many copies fit, the paper orientation and canvas dimensions, and the printable photo rectangles at 300 ppi. Coordinates are in pixels from the top left. A zero copy count means the photo does not fit. Takes size settings only.

photo_size.description: Finished photo preset. us2x2 is exactly 50.8 × 50.8 mm.

paper_size.description: Paper preset. 4x6 and 10x15 denote different paper sizes.

orientation.description: auto chooses the orientation with the most copies.

gap_mm.description: Requested gap between photos, in millimeters.
